definitions.explanation: A facility providing childcare for infants and young children, typically while parents work.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}を{保育園|ほいくえん}に{預|あず}けている。
examples.english: I leave my child at nursery school.

examples.japanese: {保育園|ほいくえん}に{入|はい}れなくて{困|こま}っている。
examples.english: I'm having trouble because I can't get a place at nursery school.

examples.japanese: {毎朝|まいあさ}{保育園|ほいくえん}に{送|おく}ってから{出勤|しゅっきん}する。
examples.english: I drop the child off at nursery school every morning before going to work.

notes:
{保育園|ほいくえん} is a compound: {保育|ほいく} (childcare) + {園|えん} (institution).

CONTRAST WITH {幼稚園|ようちえん}:
- {保育園|ほいくえん}: Childcare-focused, ages 0-5, longer hours (for working parents)
- {幼稚園|ようちえん}: Education-focused, ages 3-5, shorter hours

SYNONYMS:
- {保育所|ほいくしょ} (more formal term)
- {託児所|たくじしょ} (childcare facility)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {保育園|ほいくえん}に{預|あず}ける (to leave at nursery school)
- {保育園|ほいくえん}に{入|はい}れる (to get into nursery school)
- {待機|たいき}{児童|じどう} (children on waiting lists)

CULTURAL NOTE:
{保育園|ほいくえん} shortage ({待機|たいき}{児童|じどう}{問題|もんだい}) has been a significant social issue in Japan, particularly in urban areas where demand exceeds supply.
